description: Enhanced boundary coverage for deployment script attachment: a project carrying both pre-deployment and post-deployment payloads simultaneously, and a post-deployment-only payload with multiple batch-separated statements against a distinct schema object.

sql_files.Table1.sql:
CREATE TABLE [dbo].[Table1]
(
	c1 int NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY,
	c2 int NULL
)

cases.expected_output:
exit_code=0
package_exists=true
tables=[dbo].[Table1]
views=
pre_deploy_script=true
post_deploy_script=true
diagnostics=none

sql_files.Inventory.sql:
CREATE TABLE [dbo].[Inventory]
(
	sku int NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY,
	qty int NULL
)
sql_files.Script.PostDeployment1.sql:
-- seed inventory
INSERT INTO Inventory VALUES (10, 5)
GO
INSERT INTO Inventory VALUES (20, 7)
GO
INSERT INTO Inventory VALUES (30, 9)
GO

cases.expected_output:
exit_code=0
package_exists=true
tables=[dbo].[Inventory]
views=
pre_deploy_script=false
post_deploy_script=true
diagnostics=none
